c1-chain.title: Chaining Clauses
c1-chain.pattern: الفعل + لأن + سبب + و/بس + نتيجة (verb + because + reason + and/but + result)
c1-chain.explanation: At this level, sentences stop being single statements and start chaining reason and result together: بشوف بيت جديد اليوم لأن هاد قديم كتير، وعندي فلوس منيح (I'm seeing a new house today because this one is very old, and I have good money). Each clause stays simple -- the skill is stringing 2-3 of them together fluently, the way real spoken Syrian Arabic naturally runs on.
c1-chain.fact: Long chained sentences like this are exactly how Syrian Arabic speakers naturally tell a story or explain a decision out loud -- rarely as one flat statement, almost always as a little chain of "this, because that, so this."

lessons.title: My Uncle's Green House
lessons.context: A passage about visiting an uncle's house.

paragraphs.ar: عمي بيحب بيته الأخضر كتير، وهو قريب من البحر.
paragraphs.en: My uncle loves his green house a lot, and it's close to the sea.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي عمي بكرة، منشوف بيته سوا.
paragraphs.en: If my uncle comes tomorrow, we'll see his house together.

paragraphs.ar: خالتي بتحب تشوف عمي، عشان هني منيحين كتير سوا.
paragraphs.en: My aunt loves to see my uncle, because they're very good together.

paragraphs.ar: إختي وخيي بيحبو بيت عمي كتير، ودايما بيجوا معي.
paragraphs.en: My sister and my brother love my uncle's house a lot, and they always come with me.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! عيلتنا منيحة، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! Our family is good, thank God.

lessons.title: The Best Story I've Seen
lessons.context: A passage about a good book.

paragraphs.ar: هاي أحسن قصة شفتها، هي قصة سيف قديم.
paragraphs.en: This is the best story I've seen, it's a story of an old sword.

paragraphs.en: This book is better than this story, but the story is very cheap.

items.en: My brother comes to my house in the morning, and always loves to see my cat
items.translit: xayyi byiji beiti saba7, w daayman by7ib yshuuf 2itti

items.ar: إذا بيجي خيي صباح الجمعة، منشوف عمي سوا.
items.en: If my brother comes Friday morning, we'll see my uncle together
items.translit: iza byiji xayyi saba7 el-jum3a, minshuuf 3ammi sawa

items.ar: إختي بتحب الصباح كتير، ودايما بتاخد وقتها هلق.
items.en: My sister loves the morning a lot, and always takes her time now
items.translit: 2exti bt7ib el-saba7 ktiir, w daayman bteexud wa2tha halla2

items.ar: خيي وإختي منيحين كتير، ودايما بيجوا بيتي صباح.
items.en: My brother and my sister are very good, and always come to my house in the morning
items.translit: xayyi w 2exti mnihiin ktiir, w daayman byiju beiti saba7

lessons.title: A House Between the Bank and the Sea

items.ar: بيتنا قريب من البنك، وبعيد شوي من البحر.
items.en: Our house is close to the bank, and a little far from the sea
items.translit: beitna 2ariib min el-bank, w b3iid shwei min el-ba7er

items.ar: إذا بيجي صديقي بيتنا، بيحب يشوف البنك والبحر سوا.
items.en: If my friend comes to our house, he loves to see the bank and the sea together
items.translit: iza byiji sadee2i beitna, by7ib yshuuf el-bank wel-ba7er sawa

items.ar: عمي بيحب بيتنا كتير، عشان قريب من البنك.
items.en: My uncle loves our house a lot, because it's close to the bank
items.translit: 3ammi by7ib beitna ktiir, 3ashaan 2ariib min el-bank

items.ar: القط بيحب البحر أحسن من البنك، ودايما بيجي معي هونيك.
items.en: The cat loves the sea better than the bank, and always comes with me there
items.translit: el-2itt by7ib el-ba7er a7san min el-bank, w daayman byiji ma3i hooniik

items.ar: صديقي منيح كتير، وعنده بيت جديد قريب من بيتنا.
items.en: My friend is very good, and he has a new house close to our house
items.translit: sadee2i mnih ktiir, w 3indo beit jdiid 2ariib min beitna

items.ar: إذا بيجي بيتي بكرة، بيحب يشوف سيفي وكتابي سوا.
items.en: If he comes to my house tomorrow, he loves to see my sword and my book together
items.translit: iza byiji beiti bukra, by7ib yshuuf seifi w ktaabi sawa

items.ar: عمي بيحب صديقي كتير، ودايما بيحب يشوفه صباح الجمعة.
items.en: My uncle loves my friend a lot, and always loves to see him Friday morning
items.translit: 3ammi by7ib sadee2i ktiir, w daayman by7ib yshuufo saba7 el-jum3a

items.ar: صديقي منيح معي كتير، ودايما بيجي المدينة معي.
items.en: My friend is very good to me, and always comes to the city with me
items.translit: sadee2i mnih ma3i ktiir, w daayman byiji el-madine ma3i

items.ar: عندي سيفين، وصديقي عنده سيف واحد.
items.en: I have two swords, and my friend has one sword
items.translit: 3indi seifein, w sadee2i 3indo seif wa7id

items.ar: خيي بيحب يشوف قطي، ودايما بيشوفه صباح.
items.en: My brother loves to see my cat, and always sees it in the morning
items.translit: xayyi by7ib yshuuf 2itti, w daayman byshuufo saba7

items.ar: صديقي الجديد منيح كتير، وعنده سيف قديم غالي.
items.en: My new friend is very good, and he has an expensive old sword
items.translit: sadee2i el-jdiid mnih ktiir, w 3indo seif 2adiim ghaali

items.ar: صديقي منيح كتير معي، وعنده بيت جديد قريب من بيتنا.
items.en: My friend is very good to me, and he has a new house close to our house
items.translit: sadee2i mnih ktiir ma3i, w 3indo beit jdiid 2ariib min beitna

lessons.title: A Day of Coming and Taking

items.ar: صباح، باخد قهوتي وبجي البنك.
items.en: In the morning, I take my coffee and come to the bank
items.translit: saba7, baxud 2ahweti w bjii el-bank

items.ar: بعدها بشوف عمي، وباخد وقتي معه.
items.en: After that I see my uncle, and take my time with him
items.translit: ba3dha bshuuf 3ammi, w baxud wa2ti ma3o

items.ar: إذا بيجي خيي معي، منجي بيت خالي سوا.
items.en: If my brother comes with me, we'll come to my uncle's house together
items.translit: iza byiji xayyi ma3i, mniji beit xaali sawa

items.ar: منيح كتير! هاد اليوم منيح، عندي أهل منيحين.
items.en: Very good! This day is good, I have a good family
items.translit: mnih ktiir! had el-yom mnih, 3indi 2ahl mnihiin

items.ar: بخلص شغلتي، وبعدها بشوف قصة السيف.
items.en: I finish my matter, and after that I see the sword's story
items.translit: bxeles shaghelti, w ba3dha bshuuf 2issit el-seif

items.ar: صديقي بيخلص شغلته هلق، وبعدها بشوف السيف.
items.en: My friend finishes his matter now, and after that he sees the sword
items.translit: sadee2i byixles shaghelto halla2, w ba3dha bshuuf el-seif

items.ar: إذا بتخلصي القصة اليوم، منشوف السيف بكرة سوا.
items.en: If you finish the story today, we'll see the sword together tomorrow
items.translit: iza btexlasi el-2issa el-yom, minshuuf el-seif bukra sawa

items.ar: عمي مؤكد بيحب القصة، وبيخلصها هلق.
items.en: My uncle certainly loves the story, and finishes it now
items.translit: 3ammi m2akkad by7ib el-2issa, w byixlesha halla2

items.ar: خالي غني، بس صديقنا فقير، وهني منيحين سوا.
items.en: My uncle is rich, but our friend is poor, and they're good together
items.translit: xaali ghani, bass sadee2na fa2iir, w hinni mnihiin sawa

items.ar: إذا بيجي خالي بيتنا، بيحب يشوف صديقنا الفقير.
items.en: If my uncle comes to our house, he loves to see our poor friend
items.translit: iza byiji xaali beitna, by7ib yshuuf sadee2na el-fa2iir

items.ar: صديقنا الفقير عنده كتاب منيح، وخالي عنده سيف غالي.
items.en: Our poor friend has a good book, and my uncle has an expensive sword
items.translit: sadee2na el-fa2iir 3indo ktaab mnih, w xaali 3indo seif ghaali

items.ar: دايما بيحبو بيشوفو صديقهم صباح الجمعة، وهني منيحين كتير.
items.en: They always love to see their friend Friday morning, and they're very good
items.translit: daayman by7ibbu byshuufu sadee2on saba7 el-jum3a, w hinni mnihiin ktiir

lessons.title: A New Book at the Bank's City

items.ar: خالي شاف سيف قديم قريب من البحر.
items.en: My uncle saw an old sword close to the sea
items.translit: xaali shaaf seif 2adiim 2ariib min el-ba7er

items.ar: إذا بيجي المدينة بكرة، بيحب يشوف الكتاب معي.
items.en: If he comes to the city tomorrow, he loves to see the book with me
items.translit: iza byiji el-madine bukra, by7ib yshuuf el-ktaab ma3i

items.ar: صديقي بيحب المدينة، عشان عنده بيت غالي هونيك.
items.en: My friend loves the city, because he has an expensive house there
items.translit: sadee2i by7ib el-madine, 3ashaan 3indo beit ghaali hooniik

items.ar: القط بيحب المدينة كمان، ودايما بيجي معي صباح.
items.en: The cat loves the city too, and always comes with me in the morning
items.translit: el-2itt by7ib el-madine kamaan, w daayman byiji ma3i saba7

items.ar: صباح، باخد قهوتي وبشوف عمي.
items.en: In the morning, I take my coffee and see my uncle
items.translit: saba7, baxud 2ahweti w bshuuf 3ammi

items.ar: بخلص شغلتي هلق، وبعدها بشوف قصة السيف.
items.en: I finish my matter now, and after that I see the sword's story
items.translit: bxeles shaghelti halla2, w ba3dha bshuuf 2issit el-seif

items.ar: عمي غني كتير، بس صديقنا فقير، وهني منيحين سوا.
items.en: My uncle is very rich, but our friend is poor, and they're good together
items.translit: 3ammi ghani ktiir, bass sadee2na fa2iir, w hinni mnihiin sawa

items.ar: عمي بيحب المدينة، عشان عنده صديق منيح هونيك.
items.en: My uncle loves the city, because he has a good friend there
items.translit: 3ammi by7ib el-madine, 3ashaan 3indo sadee2 mnih hooniik

items.ar: كم أخ عندك؟ عندي خي واحد.
items.en: How many brothers do you have? I have one brother
items.translit: kam 2akh 3indak? 3indi xayyi wa7id

items.ar: مين بيجي معك بكرة؟ ولدي بيجي معي.
items.en: Who comes with you tomorrow? My son comes with me
items.translit: miin byiji ma3ak bukra? weldi byiji ma3i

items.ar: إيمتى بتخلصي شغلتك؟ بخلصها صباح الجمعة.
items.en: When do you finish your matter? I finish it Friday morning
items.translit: eimta btexlasi shaghletik? bxelesha saba7 el-jum3a

items.ar: وين بتحبي تشوفي بنتي؟ بحبها هون، قريب منك.
items.en: Where do you love to see my daughter? I love her here, close to you
items.translit: wein bt7ibbi tshuufi binti? ba7ibba hoon, 2ariib minnak

items.ar: عندي كتابين، وصديقي عنده كتاب واحد بس.
items.en: I have two books, and my friend has only one book
items.translit: 3indi ktaabein, w sadee2i 3indo ktaab wa7id bass

items.ar: بدي مي وقهوة، وصديقي بيحب الشاي بس.
items.en: I want water and coffee, and my friend loves only tea
items.translit: baddi mai w 2ahwe, w sadee2i by7ib el-shai bass

items.ar: إذا بيجي ولدك، منشوف بيته الجديد سوا.
items.en: If your son comes, we'll see his new house together
items.translit: iza byiji weldak, minshuuf beito el-jdiid sawa

items.ar: بنتك بتحب المي كتير، ودايما بتاخد كتير منه.
items.en: Your daughter loves water a lot, and always takes a lot of it
items.translit: bintak bt7ib el-mai ktiir, w daayman bteexud ktiir minno

items.ar: خالتي منيحة معي، وعمتي منيحة كمان.
items.en: My aunt is good to me, and my aunt is good too
items.translit: xalti mniha ma3i, w 3amti mniha kamaan

items.ar: إذا بيجي ولد عمي بكرة، منشوف بنت خالتي سوا.
items.en: If my uncle's son comes tomorrow, we'll see my aunt's daughter together
items.translit: iza byiji weld 3ammi bukra, minshuuf bint xalti sawa

items.ar: إيمتى بتجي عمتي؟ بتجي بكرة صباح.
items.en: When does my aunt come? She comes tomorrow morning
items.translit: eimta btiji 3amti? btiji bukra saba7

items.ar: مين بيحب الكتاب الجديد؟ ولد خالتي بيحبه كتير.
items.en: Who loves the new book? My aunt's son loves it a lot
items.translit: miin by7ib el-ktaab el-jdiid? weld xalti by7ibbo ktiir

items.ar: ولده منيح كتير، وبنتها منيحة كمان.
items.en: His son is very good, and her daughter is good too
items.translit: weldo mnih ktiir, w bintha mniha kamaan

items.ar: إذا بيجي ولده معه، بيحب يشوف بنتها.
items.en: If his son comes with him, he loves to see her daughter
items.translit: iza byiji weldo ma3o, by7ib yshuuf bintha

items.ar: شو بدك تشوفي؟ بدي بشوف ولدي وبنتي سوا.
items.en: What do you want to see? I want to see my son and my daughter together
items.translit: shu baddik tshuufi? baddi bshuuf weldi w binti sawa

items.ar: عمي منيح كتير مع ولده، ودايما بياخده معه.
items.en: My uncle is very good with his son, and always takes him with him
items.translit: 3ammi mnih ktiir ma3 weldo, w daayman byaaxdo ma3o

items.ar: مين بيجي معك؟ ولدي وبنتي بيجوا معي.
items.en: Who comes with you? My son and my daughter come with me
items.translit: miin byiji ma3ak? weldi w binti byiju ma3i

items.ar: بدي مي وقهوة اليوم، صديقي بيحب الشاي.
items.en: I want water and coffee today, my friend loves tea
items.translit: baddi mai w 2ahwe el-yom, sadee2i by7ib el-shai

items.ar: خالتي منيحة معي، وولد عمي بيحب الكتاب الجديد.
items.en: My aunt is good to me, and my uncle's son loves the new book
items.translit: xalti mniha ma3i, w weld 3ammi by7ib el-ktaab el-jdiid

items.ar: ولده وبنتها منيحين كتير، ودايما بيجوا سوا.
items.en: His son and her daughter are very good, and always come together
items.translit: weldo w bintha mnihiin ktiir, w daayman byiju sawa

items.ar: شفت قط منيح قريب من النهر مبارح.
items.en: I saw a good cat close to the river yesterday
items.translit: shift 2itt mnih 2ariib min el-naher mbari7

items.ar: صديقي عنده سيف واحد، وأنا عندي كتابين بس.
items.en: My friend has one sword, and I have only two books
items.translit: sadee2i 3indo seif wa7id, w ana 3indi ktaabein bass

items.ar: إذا بيجي ولدك، بيحب يشوف النهر معي.
items.en: If your son comes, he loves to see the river with me
items.translit: iza byiji weldak, by7ib yshuuf el-naher ma3i

items.ar: وين بتحبي تشوفي بنتك؟ بحبها هون، قريب من البحر.
items.en: Where do you love to see your daughter? I love her here, close to the sea
items.translit: wein bt7ibbi tshuufi bintik? ba7ibba hoon, 2ariib min el-ba7er

items.ar: مين عنده السيف الغالي؟ خالي عنده السيف.
items.en: Who has the expensive sword? My uncle has the sword
items.translit: miin 3indo el-seif el-ghaali? xaali 3indo el-seif

items.ar: كيف بيخلص عمي شغلته؟ بيخلصها هلق.
items.en: How does my uncle finish his matter? He finishes it now
items.translit: kiif byixles 3ammi shaghelto? byixlesha halla2

items.ar: شو بتحب تشوف اليوم؟ بحب بشوف قصة صديقي.
items.en: What do you love to see today? I love to see my friend's story
items.translit: shu bt7ib tshuuf el-yom? ba7ib bshuuf 2issit sadee2i

items.ar: إيمتى بتجي عيلتك؟ بتجي صباح الجمعة.
items.en: When does your family come? It comes Friday morning
items.translit: eimta btiji 3eiltak? btiji saba7 el-jum3a

lessons.title: My Grandmother's Book, My Grandfather's Sword

items.ar: كتاب تيتتي منيح كتير، وسيف جدو غالي كتير.
items.en: My grandmother's book is very good, and my grandfather's sword is very expensive
items.translit: ktaab teitti mnih ktiir, w seif jiddo ghaali ktiir

items.ar: إذا بيجي جدو بكرة، بيحب يشوف كتاب تيتتي.
items.en: If my grandfather comes tomorrow, he loves to see my grandmother's book
items.translit: iza byiji jiddo bukra, by7ib yshuuf ktaab teitti

items.ar: تيتتي بتحب سيف جدو، ودايما بتحب تشوفه.
items.en: My grandmother loves my grandfather's sword, and always loves to see it
items.translit: teitti bt7ib seif jiddo, w daayman bt7ib tshuufo

items.ar: إختي منيحة مع تيتتي، وخيي منيح مع جدو.
items.en: My sister is good with my grandmother, and my brother is good with my grandfather
items.translit: 2exti mniha ma3 teitti, w xayyi mnih ma3 jiddo

items.ar: وين عيلتك اليوم؟ عيلتي بيتنا.
items.en: Where is your family today? My family is at our house
items.translit: wein 3eiltak el-yom? 3eilti beitna

items.ar: قديش هاي القصة؟ هي رخيصة كتير بكرة.
items.en: How much is this story? It's very cheap tomorrow
items.translit: 2addeish hai el-2issa? hiyye rxiise ktiir bukra

items.ar: إيمتى بتاخدي كتابك؟ باخده بكرة صباح.
items.en: When do you take your book? I take it tomorrow morning
items.translit: eimta bteexdi ktaabik? baxdo bukra saba7

items.ar: مين معك هلق؟ ولدي وبنتي معي.
items.en: Who is with you now? My son and my daughter are with me
items.translit: miin ma3ak halla2? weldi w binti ma3i

items.ar: صديقي عنده كتابين، وأنا عندي كتاب واحد.
items.en: My friend has two books, and I have one book
items.translit: sadee2i 3indo ktaabein, w ana 3indi ktaab wa7id

items.ar: مين عنده كتاب صديقي؟ عمي عنده الكتاب.
items.en: Who has my friend's book? My uncle has the book
items.translit: miin 3indo ktaab sadee2i? 3ammi 3indo el-ktaab

items.ar: إختي بتحب كتاب تيتتي، وخيي بيحب سيف جدو.
items.en: My sister loves my grandmother's book, and my brother loves my grandfather's sword
items.translit: 2exti bt7ib ktaab teitti, w xayyi by7ib seif jiddo

items.ar: صديقي بيحب القصة، وهي أحسن من الكتاب القديم.
items.en: My friend loves the story, and it's better than the old book
items.translit: sadee2i by7ib el-2issa, w hiyye a7san min el-ktaab el-2adiim
